name: DaSiWa LTX 2.3: DragonLeap v4 (distilled)
author: Darksidewalker
note: His distilled LTX 2.3 line (DMD), fp8, as split files: 8 to 12 steps at CFG 1, no distilled LoRA on top; the form reads that from the name. Image-to-video and video-to-video first, with sound. LTX's own text encoder, VAEs, projection and upscalers beside it.
